run_lu_factorization_solver: run the LUFactorization solver to compute P, L, U matrices from a square input matrix
solve_lu_factorization: solve the LU factorization problem by decomposing matrix A into permutation, lower, and upper triangular matrices
validate_lu_solution: validate an LU factorization solution by checking P, L, U matrices reconstruct the original matrix
test_lu_factorization: test the LUFactorization class solve method with a sample square matrix and verify correctness
refactor_lu_factorization_solve: refactor the LUFactorization solve method to use block LU decomposition for better cache utilization
